meta.name: Eternally Yours
meta.description: Charles and Liz are a charming, married 500-year-old vampire couple whose relationship has survived centuries because, as vampires, divorce isn’t exactly an option. Together, they navigate modern society and their daughter dating a human.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Max finds his world turned upside down when he discovers the truth about his girlfriend's mysterious family.

videos.title: Baby Vampire
videos.overview: Max and Emma try to process their new reality; Charles attempts to make a new friend at work; the coven comes together in a crisis.

videos.title: The Mistake
videos.overview: The coven throws an initiation party for a new vampire and invites prominent members of their community; Jesse's vampire origin story is revealed.

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: Liz invites her boss and his wife over for drinks on Halloween; the coven fears Max has placed them in danger of a werewolf attack when he inadvertently uses an ancient protective relic as a candy bowl for trick-or-treaters, and it goes missing.

videos.title: Steve's Dream
videos.overview: Max invites Steve the Blood Guy over for game night, a kind gesture that inadvertently leads Steve to decide to leave Seattle – and sends the coven on a desperate hunt for a new blood supply. Also, Liz and Phyllis wrestle for control of the house’s interior design.

videos.title: Eternal Sunshine of Phyllis's Mind
videos.overview: Jesse contemplates whether it is finally time to tell Phyllis his secret.

videos.title: Jesse's Girl
videos.overview: The coven works together to try to find Phyllis, who has gone missing. Meanwhile, Max takes a mandatory class for new vampires.
